classes.name: Units
classes.summary: This package provides all the facilities to create and question a dictionary of units, and also to manipulate measurements which are real values with units.

staticMethods.name: UnitsFile
staticMethods.comment: Defines the location of the file containing all the information useful in creating the dictionary of all the units known to the system.

staticMethods.name: LexiconFile
staticMethods.comment: Defines the location of the file containing the lexicon useful in manipulating composite units.

staticMethods.name: DictionaryOfUnits
staticMethods.comment: Returns a unique instance of the dictionary of units. If <amode> is True, then it forces the recomputation of the dictionary of units.

staticMethods.name: FirstQuantity
staticMethods.comment: Returns the first quantity string founded from the unit <aUnit>.

staticMethods.name: LexiconUnits
staticMethods.comment: Returns a unique instance of the {@link Units_Lexicon | `Units_Lexicon`}. If <amode> is True, it forces the recomputation of the dictionary of units, and by consequence the completion of the {@link Units_Lexicon | `Units_Lexicon`}.

staticMethods.name: LexiconFormula
staticMethods.comment: Return a unique instance of LexiconFormula.

staticMethods.name: NullDimensions

staticMethods.name: Convert
staticMethods.signature: (avalue: number, afirstunit: string, asecondunit: string): number

staticMethods.name: ToSI_2

staticMethods.name: FromSI_2

classes.name: Units_Dimensions
classes.summary: This class includes all the methods to create and manipulate the dimensions of the physical quantities.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (amass: number, alength: number, atime: number, anelectriccurrent: number, athermodynamictemperature: number, anamountofsubstance: number, aluminousintensity: number, aplaneangle: number, asolidangle: number)
constructors.comment: Returns a Dimensions object which represents the dimension of a physical quantity. Each of the <amass>, <alength>, <atime>, <anelectriccurrent>, <athermodynamictemperature>, <anamountofsubstance>, <aluminousintensity>, <aplaneangle>, <asolidangle> are the powers for the 7 fundamental units of physical quantity and the 2 secondary fundamental units of physical quantity.

instanceMethods.name: Mass
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the power of mass stored in the dimensions.

instanceMethods.name: Length
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the power of length stored in the dimensions.

instanceMethods.name: Time
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the power of time stored in the dimensions.

instanceMethods.name: ElectricCurrent
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the power of electrical intensity (current) stored in the dimensions.

instanceMethods.name: ThermodynamicTemperature
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the power of temperature stored in the dimensions.

instanceMethods.name: AmountOfSubstance
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the power of quantity of material (mole) stored in the dimensions.

instanceMethods.name: LuminousIntensity
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the power of light intensity stored in the dimensions.

instanceMethods.name: PlaneAngle
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the power of plane angle stored in the dimensions.

instanceMethods.name: SolidAngle
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the power of solid angle stored in the dimensions.

instanceMethods.name: Quantity
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the quantity string of the dimension.

instanceMethods.name: Multiply
instanceMethods.comment: Creates and returns a new Dimensions object which is the result of the multiplication of <me> and <adimensions>.

instanceMethods.name: Divide
instanceMethods.comment: Creates and returns a new Dimensions object which is the result of the division of <me> by <adimensions>.

instanceMethods.name: Power
instanceMethods.comment: Creates and returns a new Dimensions object which is the result of the power of <me> and <anexponent>.

instanceMethods.name: IsEqual
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if <me> and <adimensions> have the same dimensions, false otherwise.

instanceMethods.name: IsNotEqual
instanceMethods.comment: Returns false if <me> and <adimensions> have the same dimensions, true otherwise.

instanceMethods.name: Dump
instanceMethods.comment: Useful for degugging.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Returns an instance of this class. <avalue> defines the measurement, and <atoken> the token which defines the unit used.

constructors.comment: Returns an instance of this class. <avalue> defines the measurement, and <aunit> the unit used, described in natural language.

instanceMethods.name: Convert

instanceMethods.name: Divide

instanceMethods.name: Power

classes.name: Units_ShiftedToken
classes.summary:
The ShiftedToken class inherits from Token and describes tokens which have a gap in addition of the multiplicative factor. This kind of token allows the description of linear functions which do not pass through the origin, of the form:
y = ax +b
where <x> and <y> are the unknown variables, the mutiplicative factor, and **the gap relative to the ordinate axis.**
**An example is the translation between the Celsius and Fahrenheit degree of temperature.**

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (aword: string, amean: string, avalue: number, amove: number, adimensions: Units_Dimensions)
constructors.comment: Creates and returns a shifted token. <aword> is a string containing the available word, <amean> gives the signification of the token, <avalue> is the numeric value of the dimension, <amove> is the gap, and <adimensions> is the dimension of the given word <aword>.

instanceMethods.name: Creates
instanceMethods.comment: Creates and returns a token, which is a ShiftedToken.

instanceMethods.name: Move
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the gap <themove>.

instanceMethods.name: Multiplied
instanceMethods.comment: This virtual method is called by the Measurement methods, to compute the measurement during a conversion.

instanceMethods.name: Divided
instanceMethods.comment: This virtual method is called by the Measurement methods, to compute the measurement during a conversion.

instanceMethods.name: Dump
instanceMethods.comment: Useful for debugging.

classes.name: Units_ShiftedUnit
classes.summary: This class is useful to describe units with a shifted origin in relation to another unit. A well known example is the Celsius degrees in relation to Kelvin degrees. The shift of the Celsius origin is 273.15 Kelvin degrees.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates and returns a unit. <aname> is the name of the unit.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates and returns a unit. <aname> is the name of the unit, <asymbol> is the usual abbreviation of the unit.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (aname: string, asymbol: string, avalue: number, amove: number, aquantity: Units_Quantity)
constructors.comment:
Creates and returns a shifted unit. <aname> is the name of the unit, <asymbol> is the usual abbreviation of the unit, <avalue> is the value in relation to the International System of {@link Units | `Units`}, and <amove> is the gap in relation to another unit.
For example Celsius degree of temperature is an instance of ShiftedUnit with <avalue> equal to 1. and <amove> equal to 273.15.

instanceMethods.name: Move
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the field <themove> to <amove>.

instanceMethods.name: Move
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the shifted value <themove>.

instanceMethods.name: Token
instanceMethods.comment: This redefined method returns a ShiftedToken object.

instanceMethods.name: Dump
instanceMethods.comment: Useful for debugging.

classes.name: Units_Token

constructors.comment: Creates and returns a token. <aword> is a string containing the available word, <amean> gives the signification of the token, <avalue> is the numeric value of the dimension, and <adimensions> is the dimension of the given word <aword>.
